cards.text: Crowds of people are getting baptized, and Jesus is baptized right along with them. No VIP line, no cutting ahead, just one more person in the water.

cards.question: Jesus has just been baptized. Heaven opens while He is teaching the crowd.
Heaven opens over Jesus while He prays. Who comes down on Him?

cards.text: The Holy Spirit comes down on Jesus in a bodily form. Not a hunch. Not a vibe. A SHAPE, friend, and I'm a cookie stamper, so shapes are my WHOLE career.

cards.question: The Holy Spirit comes down on Jesus in a bodily form like a ___.

cards.text: A DOVE. Friend, I named a whole station after Minty, and when I read this part I got chills all the way down to my gold base. Then a voice comes from heaven, talking right to Jesus.

cards.question: The voice from heaven speaks to Jesus. What does it call Him?
The voice from heaven also tells Jesus it is well pleased with Him.

cards.text: Then comes a detail about when Jesus begins His ministry. Friend, I sat in a drawer for YEARS before my big job showed up, so you KNOW I'm leaning in on this one.

cards.question: Jesus is about ___ years old when He begins His ministry.

cards.text: Then Luke gives Jesus' family line, and friend, it's LONGER than every receipt in my old junk drawer stacked together. It starts with Joseph, since Jesus was regarded as his son, and runs back through David, Judah, Abraham and Noah, all the way to Adam, the son of God.

findings.problem: The passage opens in the middle of a scene. 'All the people were being baptized' depends on John's baptizing ministry from the passage before (Luke 3:3-20), but the opening card never says why the crowds are being baptized. Any fix has to keep Luke's wording open: Luke 3:21 never says who baptized Jesus, and Luke 3:20 has just put John in prison.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on. If the passage starts in the middle of a thought, it gives the context.

findings.problem: Jesus appears for the first time in this lesson, and the card never says simply who He is.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The story card has four sentences ('The Holy Spirit comes down…' / 'Not a hunch.' / 'Not a vibe.' / 'A SHAPE, friend…'), which is over the 1 to 2 sentence limit for a card that isn't the opening card.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The story card has three sentences ('A DOVE.' / 'Friend, I named a whole station…' / 'Then a voice comes from heaven…'), which is over the 1 to 2 sentence limit. It also carries two separate beats: his reaction to the dove, and the voice from heaven.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Luke shows up for the first time ('Then Luke gives Jesus' family line') and the card never says who he is, such as the writer of this Gospel.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
